title: Count the Number of Houses at a Certain Distance I
summary: Houses 1..n form a line with an extra street between x and y. For each k from 1 to n, count ordered house pairs whose shortest path has length k; return the counts as a 1-indexed array.
visualizationNotes: Visualization accepts 2 to 30 houses. Only one example was retrieved; the statement examples are incomplete, so requirements are not verified.
